description: Set the app's age-rating content declarations (Apple computes 4+/9+/12+/17+). Pass a declarations map, e.g. { medicalOrTreatmentInformation: "INFREQUENT_OR_MILD" }. Pro feature.

declarations.description: Map of declaration key to value. Frequency keys take NONE/INFREQUENT_OR_MILD/FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE (also INFREQUENT/FREQUENT for the few keys Apple uses those on); capability keys take true/false.

name: set_age_rating
title: Set the age rating
